A/B tests of paywalls and feature flags: set up arms, start, follow the results, and conclude with a
winner.

An experiment splits end users between arms. Each arm shows a paywall at its paywall locations,
gives feature flags a value, or both. What counts as a conversion is fixed once it starts, and the
arms are locked while it runs.

Usage:
  voidhash experiment <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  experiment, experiments

Commands:
  list       List the project's experiments with their status and arms.
  view       Show an experiment: its status, metric and what each arm does.
  create     Set up an experiment as a draft, optionally with its arms.
  edit       Change an experiment's name, hypothesis, metrics or arms.
  start      Start or resume an experiment.
  pause      Pause an experiment: everyone sees the control arm until it resumes.
  results    Show how each arm converts, with an honest verdict.
  conclude   End an experiment for good with a winner.
  archive    Archive a draft or concluded experiment.
  restore    Bring back an archived experiment.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash experiment <command> --help' for more about a command.
